sources.articleTitle: China, Russia and US agree peace declaration with no mention of Ukraine and Iran wars
China’s Xi urges US and Russia to join forces to safeguard world peace

headline: Leaders Of China, Russia And The United States Issue Peace Statement
seoTitle: China, Russia And US Issue Peace Declaration
metaDescription: President Xi Jinping, President Vladimir Putin, and President Donald Trump have released a joint peace statement following an unprecedented summit.
aiSummaryBullets: President Xi Jinping requested that the United States and Russia collaborate with China to maintain global peace.
The three nations released a joint declaration outlining shared priorities including United Nations reform and energy security.
The issued peace statement contains no references to the ongoing conflicts in Ukraine or Iran.
aiContextParagraph: Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and United States President Donald Trump have held a trilateral summit resulting in a formal peace statement. The meeting focused on establishing a collective framework for international stability, with the resulting declaration highlighting several key areas of cooperation. Among the stated priorities are mandates for the reform of the United Nations, initiatives to increase global oil supplies, and the strengthening of protections regarding diplomatic immunity. Despite the breadth of the summit's topics, observers have noted that the official text omits any discussion or mention of the active military conflicts currently involving participants in Ukraine and Iran. This development marks an unprecedented diplomatic engagement between the three global powers, aiming to set a course for future trilateral interaction and multilateral policy governance on the world stage.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining attention due to coverage by two independent major outlets following an unprecedented diplomatic summit between the three world leaders.
